.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/create/.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> to scaffold the class, where <id> is the class identifier (e.g. kebab-case or camelCase) to convert to PascalCase for the generated file.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/list/st.instruction: Run {{script}} [searchTerm] to list all classes (optionally filtered to those whose file contents include searchTerm).

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/update/.instruction: Run the script as `{{script}} <id> <change-request>`, where `<id>` is the class identifier to check and `<change-request>` is the requested change (unused by this step but accepted as input).

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/delete/.instruction: Run {{script}} <id> where <id> is the class identifier to delete.
Run `{{script}} <id>` where `<id>` is the class id, to print every existing reference to that class in the codebase as `[file path]:[line number]` lines.

.gstudio/artifacts/class/scripts/evaluat.instruction: Run `{{script}} <id>` where `<id>` is the class identifier to evaluate against `src/classes/{PascalCaseId}.class.ts`.

create.text: Scaffolds a new class file at src/classes/{Name}.class.ts given a class id and optional initial content, failing if it already exists.

list.text: Lists classes defined under src/classes whose id or path matches an optional search term, printing each as id: file path.

update.text: Modifies an existing class file at src/classes/{name}.class.ts to satisfy a given change request, erroring if the class does not exist.

delete.text: Deletes a class file by id from src/classes, then finds and removes all dangling references to it in the codebase.

evaluate.text: Checks that a class file matches the required location, shape, and scoping rules for a given class id, printing discrepancies as ERROR_CODE: message and exiting nonzero if any are found.
